sections.title: Purpose
sections.descriptorLine: Approved deployment posture for the connector pilot.

blocks.text: This Deployment Summary records the approved posture for the Microsoft 365 Copilot connector at Fixture Client. It states what was deployed, who may use it, which controls apply, and what the client is acknowledging. It is a governance record of the deployment as approved, not a configuration guide.

Scope is limited to the approved pilot group in the Fixture Tenant environment. Anything not listed as in scope below is out of scope, and expanding scope requires a new approval rather than an operational decision.

rows: General staff, contractors, and external guests
Credential handling and final decision automation
Business content in configured connector sources
Regulated, health, legal, and client-confidential data
Any other tenant or unmanaged device

blocks.text: Access is granted through the approved pilot group and through managed business accounts only. Membership changes flow through the designated security owner, so the access boundary stays reviewable rather than drifting through ad hoc grants.

items: Group membership is the single point of access control
Access requests are approved by the designated security owner
Removal from the group revokes access at the next sign-in
Shared and service accounts are not permitted in the pilot

blocks.text: The controls below were agreed before deployment and are the baseline against which the pilot is reviewed.

rows: Approved pilot group with managed accounts
Signed acceptable use policy before first access
Tenant audit logging validated before reliance

blocks.text: Audit visibility was reviewed during deployment. What follows is a statement of the limits on that visibility, so that no party assumes an evidentiary capability that has not been validated in this tenant.

rows: Approves access, owns the access boundary, receives escalations
Maintains configuration and validates audit logging
Use the connector within approved purpose and verify all output
Delivers training, maintains this record, supports the pilot

blocks.text: By accepting this Deployment Summary, Fixture Client acknowledges the scope, access model, control framework, and audit limitations recorded above, and accepts that any deviation from them requires review before implementation.
v1.0 initial issue. This record is reviewed at least every six months, or sooner if scope, access model, or control posture changes.
